remote_play.video: Capture the actual Worker-rendered HTML canvas; browser WebRTC encoding
remote_play.audio: Optional MediaStream branch from the existing AudioWorklet node; independent local monitor mute
remote_play.pairing: Versioned manual offer/answer or local Python server with one-time code and remembered approved devices; fresh LAN ICE with optional same-server UDP STUN address discovery; no TURN
remote_play.frontend: Approved phone can bootstrap windowed host RetroArch; native or web controller; runtime changes replace media on the same connection; authorized pause/resume closes game menu; watchdog releases input
remote_play.input: Reliable control channel; unordered input snapshots without retransmission; 500 ms release watchdog
remote_play.validation: See docs/remote-play.md; real-game two-context WebRTC and 5-minute stream stability

core_worker.fallback: Existing main-thread runtime on missing features or startup failure

readback_prewarm.failure: Cancel the new generation before resume; restore previous guest state and files on transaction failure; stay paused if rollback fails
readback_prewarm.audio: Consume the existing once-only topup before core work on ready blocking Worker AudioWorklet; other paths retain first-flush fallback

audio_worker_wait.early_notifications: Do not exhaust the elapsed-time budget
audio_worker_wait.validation: See docs/wasm-audio-wait.md; shared-memory JIT-on A-H ABBA and 5-minute H stability run

audio_refresh_wait.active_output: Limit Worker refresh wait to queued audio minus two nominal core frames
audio_refresh_wait.inactive_output: Retain existing 100 ms refresh wait for paused, suspended, nonblocking or unavailable output
audio_refresh_wait.validation: See docs/wasm-refresh-audio-budget.md; shared-memory JIT-on A-H ABBA and 5-minute D/H stability runs

experimental_wasm_jit.scope: A320 integer/MUL, MULT/MULTU, MADD/MADDU, MFHI/MFLO, MOVZ/MOVN and bounded RAM/framebuffer prefixes; terminal BEQ/BNE delay pairs and bounded single-store self-loops without HI/LO writes
